g.text: Local T-cell clone repetition is higher in older thymus and spleen samples; marrow shows a different age pattern. Points are mice and black bars are means. Bottom
panels condition on tissue-specific sampling depth, so their magnitudes are not directly comparable across tissues. T-cell subtype, assembly selection and function
